description: The completed eBay sales behind the sold comps, one row per sale, newest first: date, site, price as paid (`native`) and converted, grade, seller-stated condition, title, best_offer_accepted (then the buyer may have paid less than shown). Use it to judge a thin sample. Only sellers based in the site's own country are listed. Requires the ultra plan or higher. Cost: 1 unit.

card_id.description: Flipzi card id (UUID). Get it from flipzi_search_cards or flipzi_list_set_cards.

condition.description: Only ungraded copies whose eBay titles state this condition (near mint, lightly/moderately/heavily played, damaged; seller-stated, not verified). Implies grade RAW. Omit for the price across conditions (which leaves out hp and dmg). Pro and above.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Default standard; a finish the card does not have returns an empty result.

grade.description: Grade code, e.g. RAW, PSA_10, BGS_9.5. Graded values need the Pro plan.

language.description: Listing language: EN, JA, DE, FR, IT, ES, ZH. Default: every language.

period.description: How far back, within your plan's history depth. Default 90d.

name: flipzi_get_sales
title: Individual eBay sales
